profile: regression: Regression is a learning problem in which a model is fit to training data to make predictions about a continuous-valued output. It is one of two problem forms, along with classification, distinguished by the numerical form of the output. Linear regression fits a representative line or, in higher dimensions, a hyperplane to input/output data points. An example is predicting share price.
